Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: Matt is a tall, eleven-year-old boy. He has a scar on his right cheek. He is intelligent and an excellent drummer. Which of his traits did he most likely inherit?
A. his height
B. his scar on his right cheek
C. his intelligence
D. his ability to play the drums
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
